1. Build the list of sigmas from the smallest to the largest, spaced evenly in log sigma.
2. For each sigma, correlate the image with the derivative-of-Gaussian kernels the measure needs.
3. Combine the derivatives into the measure and multiply it by its normalization factor.
4. At each pixel, keep the value of largest absolute value and the sigma where it was found.
5. Output the kept value, or the kept sigma.
